verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a first-party bulk payment capability: a dedicated bulk payment authorisation endpoint (yapily-docs-29), and bulk is listed among the payment types supported via the direct API, though not via Hosted pages (yapily-docs-17). Bulk support is evidenced only for payment initiation, and nothing describes how bulk requests are structured, their limits, or per-item status handling. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond payments (e.g. data retrieval or consent management), documentation of batch size and partial-failure handling, bulk support in Hosted flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
